title: Providing for the appointment of Barbara Barrett as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.
official_summary: This joint resolution appoints Barbara M. Barrett as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.

summary.headline: A joint resolution that formally appoints Barbara Barrett as a citizen regent on the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
summary.what_it_does: This joint resolution names Barbara M. Barrett as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. The Smithsonian is a federal museum and research network, and its Board of Regents oversees it. The summary does not describe any other duties, funding, or rules beyond this appointment.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution
who_it_affects.how: The board gains Barbara Barrett as one of its citizen regents.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 23, 2021.
